verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a first-party Commit Graph, reachable from the Repository screen, for exploring changes across branches. This directly matches the story, though the documentation is only one brief line. Missing for 10: detail on graph rendering and depth (e.g., whether all branches and remotes appear, merge visualization, filtering), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can visualize the full commit graph across branches

citations.quote: To explore repository changes across branches use the Commit Graph available from the Repository screen.
